correctness.rationale: Direct chain-rule factorization yields strictly positive degree-n product denominators with a cancelled monic leading coefficient; polynomial root bound proves n−1. Root neighborhoods prove sharpness for prescribed indices. The three-stage coefficient criteria are necessary and sufficient via quadratic roots. Exact six-bracket cubic certificate verifies positive admissible stage thresholds; checker.py reproduces rational witnesses and 30,000 exact comparisons. Scope and exceptional identical-polynomial case explicitly handled.

value.rationale: There is a motivated ecological comparison problem where fuel-treatment efficacy depends on weather and logistic fire severity models are used. The ceiling supplies a falsifiable structure diagnostic (more than n−1 flips disproves the model), the construction shows two reversals in three physically admissible conditional stages despite individually increasing risk curves, and an exact coefficient test identifies the entire double-reversal region. It does not assert field-calibrated effectiveness or novelty of elementary polynomial algebra.
